delivery.site: Damac Lagoons -- Mykonos Cluster, Dubailand, Dubai, UAE
delivery.programme: Phased against the cluster handover programme; 4 weeks' notice per release.

line_items.description: Porcelain floor tile, FOH corridors -- rectified, matt finish
Porcelain wall tile, FOH lobby feature wall
Matching skirting, cut from the floor tile above

lump_sums.description: Attic stock -- 2% of each item, delivered and stacked at the site store

additional_terms: Rates are fixed for the full duration of the order and are not subject to escalation.
Deliveries are to be made against written release notices only; material delivered without a release notice is at the supplier's risk.
All items on this order are to be from a single production batch unless DAMAC approves otherwise in writing.
notes: Attic stock is to be delivered with the final release and handed over against a signed store receipt.
